 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. A longstanding SEC rivalry will rekindle on Saturday as the Auburn Tigers visit the Mississippi State Bulldogs at Davis Wade Stadium.
 Saturday's game will be the 98th meeting between the Tigers and the Bulldogs , and the first since the 2023 season. Auburn won the last meeting, 27-14, at Jordan-Hare Stadium on Oct. 28, 2023, snapping a two-game losing streak in the series.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement No matter the result of Saturday's game, it will already be one of the most memorable matchups in series history.
 Friday's FAA ground stop altered Auburn's travel plans and forced the SEC to change the start time of Saturday's game. Auburn boarded its plane in Columbus, Georgia, on Friday, but ultimately had to disembark due to the nationwide ground stop.
 The team bussed from Columbus to the team hotel in Tupelo, Mississippi, putting their travel plans behind schedule by several hours. Because of this, the game will now begin at 3:15 p.m. CT instead of its original 11 a.m. CT start time.
 Follow along for highlights, injury news, key plays, and instant breakdown as Auburn takes on Vanderbilt in a pivotal SEC showdown.
